$comment: Descriptions, enumerations and limits of the fields of the signature API request bodies, written from the REST manual (14.5, 14.20, 14.21, 14.25). The OpenAPI document carries no descriptions. Key: "Schema.Field" (short OpenAPI schema name) or "*.Field" for any schema; the most specific wins. Per-field options: description, enum, min, max, minLength, maxLength, minItems, format (url), required, default. Consumed by scripts/gen-body-schemas.ts.

SendDocumentDTO.SignersGroups.description: Groups of signers; each group is an object with its signers.

SendDocumentDTO.OrderedGroups.description: If true the groups must sign in order; if false any group can sign at any time.

SendBatchDTO.SignersGroups.description: Groups of signers of the batch; every document added to the batch is signed by these signers.

SendBatchDTO.OrderedGroups.description: If true the groups must sign in order; if false any group can sign at any time.

*.FileName.description: Name of the file. Default: the name of filePath.

SendDocumentDTO.IssuerName.description: Document issuer name shown to the signers (max 255). Required for the remote (emailandsms) channel.

SendBatchDTO.IssuerName.description: Issuer name shown to the signers (max 255). Required for batches.

EDeliveries.EDeliveryDTO.IssuerName.description: Name of the issuer shown to the recipient.

*.ExpirationDate.description: Date after which the document is deleted from VIDsigner. Format dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss.

*.NotificationURL.description: Webhook endpoint that receives status notifications. When VIDSIGNER_ALLOWED_NOTIFICATION_HOSTS is set, its host must be in that list.

*.AdditionalData.description: Free text (max 1000 characters) returned with the signed document; searchable with vidsigner_search.

EDeliveries.EDeliveryDTO.AdditionalData.description: Free text about the e-delivery returned with it.

*.Tag.description: Tag(s) used to filter documents in the VIDsigner app, separated by comma.

SendDocumentDTO.SenderName.description: Sender name (max 255). Only valid when the document has at least one centralized (mobile) signer; shown in the centralized portal.

SendBatchDTO.SenderName.description: Sender name (max 255). Only valid with centralized (mobile) signers.

SendDocumentDTO.IssuerIdentifier.description: Identifier of the issuer. Present in the OpenAPI; not described in the manual.

*.ConvertFormToReadOnly.description: If true the PDF is converted to read-only. Recommended for PDFs that contain editable forms.

*.RejectionOptions.description: Rejection reasons the signer picks from a dropdown when rejecting. At document level they apply to every signer; at signer level, to that signer only.

RejectionOptionDTO.Text.description: Rejection option description shown to the signer.

*.SignedDocumentRecipients.description: Recipients that receive the signed document by email once the document is signed. VIDSIGNER_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS restricts the domains.

*.RejectedDocumentRecipients.description: Recipients that receive the rejection notice by email once the document is rejected. VIDSIGNER_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS restricts the domains.

DocumentRecipientDTO.Email.description: Email of the recipient (required). The manual spells it eMail; both are accepted.

DocumentRecipientDTO.Language.description: Language of the email sent to the recipient, e.g. es.

SendDocumentDTO.Appearance.description: Branding of the remote signing app and of the notification emails (remote channel only).

SendBatchDTO.Appearance.description: Branding of the remote signing app and of the notification emails (remote channel only).

DocAppearanceDTO.App.description: Customisation of the remote signing application. The manual spells it APP; both are accepted.

AppAppearanceDTO.Logo.description: URL of the corporate logo shown in the remote app.

AppAppearanceDTO.PrimaryColor.description: Hexadecimal colour of the app header.

AppAppearanceDTO.PrimaryTextColor.description: Hexadecimal colour of the app header text.

AppAppearanceDTO.SecondaryColor.description: Hexadecimal colour of the app buttons.

AppAppearanceDTO.SecondaryTextColor.description: Hexadecimal colour of the app button text.

EmailNotificationAppearanceDTO.Corporate.description: URL of the corporate logo shown in the emails.
Hexadecimal background colour of the emails.
Width of the corporate logo in the emails.

*.NotificationConfig.description: Which webhook notifications are sent to NotificationURL and how they are authenticated.

*.CreatedDocNotification.description: Notify when the document is created.

*.MinGroupNotification.description: Notify when a group reaches its minimum number of signatures.

*.AuthType.description: Authentication of the webhook endpoint: BASIC or JWT.

*.APIKey.description: Name/value pair sent to the webhook as API key.

APIKeyDTO.Value.description: API key value. A secret: never put real credentials in prompts.

*.EmailStatusNotification.description: Email addresses notified of the status of the document.

*.ExcludeParams.description: Do not append the query parameters to the notification URL.

*.UseNotificationUrlAsIs.description: Use NotificationURL exactly as given, without adding path segments.

SignerGroupDTO.Min.description: Minimum signatures to close the group. Triggers the notification and unlocks the next group when ordered. Default: all signers.

SignerGroupDTO.Max.description: Maximum signatures accepted; when every group reaches it the document is signed. Default: all signers.

SignerGroupDTO.OrderedSignatures.description: If true the signers of the group must sign in order.

SignerGroupDTO.Signers.description: Signers of the group, one object per signature.

Signer.BatchSignerGroupDTO.Min.description: Minimum signatures to close the group. Default: all signers.

Signer.BatchSignerGroupDTO.Max.description: Maximum signatures accepted. Default: all signers.

Signer.BatchSignerGroupDTO.OrderedSignat.description: If true the signers of the group must sign in order.

*.SignerName.description: Full name of the signer (required for remote signatures). The manual documents SignerFullNameOrNULL: null is accepted.

*.TypeOfID.description: Type of identity document, e.g. NIF, NIE, Passport.

*.NumberID.description: Identity document number. Only letters, spaces, numbers and . - _ are accepted.

*.PhoneNumber.description: Signer phone in E.164 format, e.g. +34666666666. Required by the remote channel to send the OTP. Empty or null when AllowEmptyPhoneNumber is true. VIDSIGNER_ALLOWED_PHONE_PREFIXES restricts it.

*.AllowEmptyPhoneNumber.description: Allow an empty phone number (remote channel, SignatureType=emailandsms).

*.OTPChannel.description: Primary channel to send the OTP to the signer: sms, whatsapp or smswhatsapp. The manual spells it WhatsApp; both are accepted and normalised to whatsapp.

*.AdditionalInfo.description: Short extra information about the signer (max 25 characters, e.g. Director). Printed in the signature box when its appearance is EXTENDED.

*.Language.description: Signer language. Allowed values depend on SignatureType: bio es, ca, cs, en, gl, nl, pl, eu, iw, it, de, fr, pt; emailandsms ar, br, ca, cs, de, es, en, eu, fi, fr, gl, hu, it, ko, nl, no, pl, pt, ro, zh; mobile with SendCentralizedSignerEmailNotification es, ca, en, de, fr, nl, pt.

EDeliveries.EDeliveryDTO.Language.description: Language of the e-delivery notification, e.g. es.

*.SendSignedDoc.description: Email the signed document to the signer once it is signed.

*.DownloadDocument.description: Let the signer download and review the document during the signing flow before signing.

*.LocalSignature.description: Allow signing with a local certificate stored in AutoFirma (remote channel). Values: no, optional, mandatory. With mandatory, AllowEmptyPhoneNumber must be true.

*.AllowSignatureDelegation.description: Allow the signer to delegate the signature to another person (remote channel).

*.SignatureType.description: Signature channel: emailandsms = VIDremote (link + OTP), bio = tablet, mobile = VIDmobile (centralized), smartcard, stamp = automatic seal.

*.SkipSignatureEmail.description: If true VIDsigner does NOT email the signing link (remote channel only); fetch it with vidsigner_get_signature_url. Needs the AllowSkipEmail permission on the subscription (otherwise 409/40111). Only for the first signer when ordered, or any signer when unordered.

*.Email.description: Signer email, used for notifications. If the signer has none, send "null" or an empty string. The manual spells it eMail; both are accepted. VIDSIGNER_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS restricts the domains.

*.DeviceName.description: Name of the tablet that must be used (bio channel). If null the signer can use any device of the subscription.

*.PersonalCode.description: Personal code of the signer set by the sender.

*.SignatureReason.description: Reason why the signers should sign the document.

*.SendCentralizedSignerEmailNotification.description: Email the centralized (mobile) signer about the pending document. NotificationEmailMessage must not be empty.

*.SSICredentials.description: Self-sovereign-identity credential types accepted. Present in the OpenAPI; not described in the manual.

Signer.SignerV2DTO.Visible.description: Where the signature is drawn in the PDF.

Signer.SignerV2DTO.Form.description: Form the signer fills in before signing (FormDisplay, Layout, Sections > Groups > Title / RadioButtons / CheckBoxes / TextBoxes / Attachments).

Signer.SignerV2DTO.AdditionalSignatures.description: Extra places in the PDF where the same signature is repeated.

SignatureDataDTO.Visible.description: Where the signature of the matching signer is drawn in this PDF.

SignatureDataDTO.Form.description: Form of the matching signer for this PDF.

SignatureDataDTO.AdditionalSignatures.description: Extra places where the signature is repeated in this PDF.

SendDocumentBatchDTO.SignaturesGroups.description: Signature placement per group and signer, in the same order as the signers of the batch.

SignatureGroupDTO.Signatures.description: One entry per signer of the group, in the same order as the batch signers.

VisibleDTO.Page.description: Page of the signature. 0 = invisible, -1 = last page.

VisibleDTO.PosX.description: X position in millimetres (A4 is 210 x 297 mm; outside it the signature is relocated).

VisibleDTO.SignatureField.description: Name of an existing AcroForm signature field; PosX/PosY/SizeX/SizeY are then ignored. Cannot be combined with Anchor.

VisibleDTO.Anchor.description: Text in the PDF used as reference for the signature position; PosX/PosY are ignored and SizeX/SizeY are required. Cannot be combined with SignatureField.

*.Reminder.description: Reminders by email for remote signers (SignatureType=emailandsms). They stop when the document is signed, rejected or deleted.

*.NotificationEmailMessage.description: Custom subject and body of the notification email to the signer (required for remote signatures).

SignatureNotificationEmailDTO.eMailBody.description: Custom message of the email (max 5000). Allowed HTML: p, br, b, i, img.

StampCertificateDTO.Pin.description: PIN of the stamp certificate. A secret: provide it only when you must.

*.CentralizedCertificate.description: Centralized certificate to use (SignatureType=mobile). If set, the user can only sign with this certificate.

CentralizedCertificateDTO.CertificateGUI.description: Identifier of the centralized certificate. The manual samples spell it CertificateGUI; both are accepted.

*.SignerData.description: Collects signer data (name, ID type, ID number) inside the signing flow when it is not known beforehand (remote and bio channels).

SignerDataDto.Display.description: When the signer-data form is shown: BeforePreview or AfterPreview (VIDremote only).

SignerDataDto.SignerNameProperties.description: Whether the signer name is required and editable in the flow.

SignerDataDto.NumberIdProperties.description: Whether the ID number is required and editable in the flow.

SignerDataDto.TypeOfIdProperties.description: Whether the ID type is required and editable in the flow.

SignerDataProperties.Editable.description: The signer can edit the reported value.

SignerDataProperties.Required.description: mandatory, optional or no (for the signer name it must be mandatory).

*.Approvers.description: Approvers (centralized users, ordered list; OrderedSignatures must be true) that must approve before the signer can sign.

ApproverDTO.LegalId.description: LegalId of a centralized user of the same subscription.

ApproverDTO.SendApproverEmailNotificatio.description: Email the approver about the pending approval.

ApproverDTO.IncludeInEvidences.description: Include the approver in the evidence report. Present in the OpenAPI.

*.SignaturePolicy.description: Custom signing policy: PolicyIdentifier and PolicyCode (e.g. 2.16.724.1.3.1.1.2.1.9 and facturae).

*.Wallet.description: Allows a credential of the Wallet as second authentication factor (remote channel).

WalletDTO.Required.description: Whether wallet-based 2FA is allowed: no, optional or mandatory.

WalletDTO.Credentials.description: Credential type identifiers accepted, e.g. OpenId, EmailCredential.

Forms.FormDTO.FormDisplay.description: When the form is shown. OnPreview is only available for the remote channel.

Forms.FormDTO.Layout.description: Font and size of the form texts.

Forms.FormDTO.Sections.description: Sections of the form; each one groups fields.

Forms.FormLayoutDTO.FontFamily.description: Font of the responses printed in the document: Courier, Courier-Bold, Courier-Oblique, Courier-BoldOblique, Helvetica, Helvetica-Bold, Helvetica-Oblique, Helvetica-BoldOblique, MacRoman, Times-Bold, Times-BoldItalic, Times-Italic or Times-Roman.

Forms.FormLayoutDTO.FontSize.description: Font size of the form text, from 8 to 20 (as a string).

Forms.FormLayoutDTO.IsHTML.description: If true the titles accept HTML (br, b, i, u, p, span).

Forms.FormSectionDTO.Groups.description: Groups of fields of the section.

Forms.FormGroupDTO.RadioButtons.description: Radio buttons of the group; the user picks one choice.

Forms.FormGroupDTO.TextBoxes.description: Free text fields of the group.

Forms.FormGroupDTO.Attachments.description: File/image upload fields of the group.

Forms.FormTitleDTO.Position.description: Placement of the text in the PDF.

Forms.FormTitleDTO.DisablePrintPDF.description: Do not print the text in the PDF.

Forms.FormPositionDTO.Anchor.description: Text in the document where the element is placed.

Forms.*.Title.description: Text and placement of the title of the field.

Forms.*.Condition.description: Enables the field only when another field (Id) has the value Result.

Forms.FormConditionDTO.Id.description: Identifier of the other field of the form.

Forms.FormConditionDTO.Result.description: Value that field must have to enable this one.

Forms.*.Required.description: Whether the answer is mandatory or optional.

Forms.*.HideBorders.description: Hide the border printed in the document.

Forms.FormRadioButtonDTO.Choices.description: Options of the radio button; the user can pick only one.

Forms.FormRadioButtonDTO.SelectedChoice.description: Index of the option chosen by default or by the user.

Forms.FormRadioButtonChoiceDTO.Title.description: Text and placement of the option.

Forms.FormCheckBoxDTO.Response.description: Checked state of the check box.

Forms.FormCheckBoxDTO.Appearance.description: Printing style of the check box in the PDF: checkbox or radiobutton.

Forms.FormTextBoxDTO.MaxLines.description: Maximum number of lines the user can write (1-25).

Forms.FormTextBoxDTO.MaxLength.description: Maximum number of characters of the response.

Forms.FormTextBoxDTO.Optional.description: True if the text box is optional (OpenAPI field; prefer Required).

Forms.FormTextBoxDTO.Response.description: Response text (Text) and its placement (Position) in the PDF.

Forms.FormAttachmentDTO.Response.description: Uploaded file and where it is placed in the PDF.

Forms.FormAttachmentResponseDTO.Text.description: Uploaded image, Base64 encoded (manual spelling of FileInBase64).

Forms.FormAttachmentResponseDTO.Position.description: Placement of the uploaded image in the PDF.

Forms.FormAttachmentResponseDTO.Source.description: Origin of the uploaded file. Present in the OpenAPI.

Forms.FormAttachmentResponseDTO.ContentT.description: File type that can be uploaded: IMG (JPEG, JPG, PNG) or PDF.

Forms.FormAttachmentPositionDTO.Anchor.description: Text in the document where the image is placed.

EDeliveries.EDeliveryDTO.RecipientEmailA.description: Recipient email (required). VIDSIGNER_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS restricts the domains.

EDeliveries.EDeliveryDTO.RecipientPhoneN.description: Recipient phone in E.164 format. Required unless AllowEmptyPhoneNumber. VIDSIGNER_ALLOWED_PHONE_PREFIXES restricts it.

EDeliveries.EDeliveryDTO.AllowEmptyPhone.description: Allow sending without the recipient phone number.

EDeliveries.EDeliveryDTO.NotificationEma.description: Emails notified of the delivery events.

EDeliveries.EDeliveryDTO.SendDocToRecipi.description: Also email a copy of the document to the recipient.

EDeliveries.EDeliveryDTO.EDeliveryEmailM.description: Custom subject and body of the notification email.

EDeliveries.EDeliveryDTO.Reminder.description: Reminders sent to the recipient while the e-delivery is pending.
